parse_link: parse a reStructuredText link string in title less-than link greater-than format into separate title and link components
create_vkext_role: create a Docutils RST role that generates a reference link to a Vulkan extension specification page on Khronos
create_vkfn_role: create a Docutils RST role that generates a reference link to a Vulkan function man page on Khronos
create_vktype_role: create a Docutils RST role that generates a reference link to a Vulkan type man page on Khronos
register_mcss_roles: register the vkext, vkfn, and vktype local roles with the Docutils RST parser for use in documentation
